moments.action: At the kitchen table Amah leans in over her glasses, pressing something on M; the reverse holds on M, who answers at first but by the end has dropped his eyes to the table instead of meeting hers.

A wide held take down the plant-choked alley: Amah sits alone by the gate at the far end while a cat crosses the lane. The camera moves in closer and she is hunched on a bench, both hands on her cane, head sinking, a neighbour working on behind her.
In the cramped shop kitchen M peers through a big glass jar of dark preserved food, then turns away with a plate of cooked prawns and greens, carrying it out to the counter trays.
